interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Remove all construction materials and debris from the sidewalk to restore a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: If the sidewalk must be closed for work, provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway in the roadway with appropriate barriers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Construction Detours
interventions.description: Provide clearly marked and protected temporary walkways when construction obstructs existing sidewalks.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repave the walkway with high-quality materials to provide a level, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Delineation
interventions.description: Install defined curbs and potentially green infrastructure to clearly separate the pedestrian zone from the vehicle travel lanes.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this long, straight residential and institutional block.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a legal crossing point.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the ends of the block or potential crossing points to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway around the construction equipment to keep pedestrians out of the travel lane.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and provide space for a sidewalk buffer or bike lane.

interventions.title: Enhanced Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint or contrasting materials to clearly define the pedestrian path across the driveway.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and repave the degraded roadway to eliminate trip hazards and improve the walking surface for those crossing the street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or low plantings to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island at the crosswalk to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or a dedicated furniture zone to ensure a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to increase driver awareness of pedestrian activity.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.
